mapper.sql: FROM mine_development_data m JOIN sub_mine_development_data s ON s.mine_development_dataID = m.id JOIN mining_area_category mac ON mac.area_name = m.unit_name AND mac.level = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum
WHERE m.record_date = #{date} and s.unit_nameJSON='合计'

SELECT COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum
WHERE m.record_date = #{date} AND mac.is_separate = #{isSeparate} and s.unit_nameJSON='合计'

SELECT m.record_date AS recordDate, COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum
WHERE m.record_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND mac.is_separate = #{isSeparate} AND s.unit_nameJSON = '合计' GROUP BY m.record_date ORDER BY m.record_date ASC

SELECT m.record_date AS recordDate, COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum FROM mine_development_data m JOIN sub_mine_development_data s ON s.mine_development_dataID = m.id WHERE m.record_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND s.unit_nameJSON = '合计' GROUP BY m.record_date ORDER BY m.record_date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.day_plan), 0) AS total from mine_plan t1 left join sub_mine_plan t2 on t1.id=t2.mine_plan_id where t1.plan_type= #{dataType} and mine_category='全矿' and YEAR(t1.plan_month)= YEAR(#{Date}) and MONTH(t1.plan_month)=MONTH(#{Date}) and t2.is_deleted =0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.day_plan), 0) AS total from mine_plan t1 left join sub_mine_plan t2 on t1.id=t2.mine_plan_id where t1.plan_type= #{dataType} and mine_category='全矿' and YEAR(t1.plan_month)= YEAR(#{Date}) and MONTH(t1.plan_month)=MONTH(#{Date})

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.day_target), 0) AS total from mine_plan t1 left join sub_mine_plan t2 on t1.id=t2.mine_plan_id where t1.plan_type= #{dataType} and mine_category='全矿' and YEAR(t1.plan_month)= YEAR(#{Date}) and MONTH(t1.plan_month)=MONTH(#{Date})
